# Leyoxa

> Leyoxa LLC co-builds vertical AI companies with operators who already have customers. The operator brings the customers, the industry knowledge and a problem that costs money every week; Leyoxa brings the engineering, the AI systems and security for regulated data, and takes part of its return in equity.

Leyoxa is a Texas company founded by Sepehr Aflatounian (https://sepehrafla.github.io), based in Toronto.

## How Leyoxa builds

Observe a business with real customers, find the bottleneck, build the system, deploy it in production, measure outcomes, and when the problem is large enough to be a company, build it as one with the operator.

## First partnership

Praxis — AI for dental practices. Leyoxa is the technology partner: architecture, AI systems and platform. Six agents in production: Voice, Reputation, GEO/SEO, Smile Simulator, Executive Assistant and Call Coaching.
